description: Three clients downgraded to TLS 1.0 to reach a legacy server, each through its language's own minimum-version setting: Node mssql `cryptoCredentialsDetails.minVersion: "TLSv1"`, Python `ssl.TLSVersion.TLSv1` on an SSLContext, and Go `tls.VersionTLS10` in a tls.Config. VC122 must fire on all three.
